messages:
claire: Opening a PR to add a 'egress-lockdown' section for private/VPC installs behind very strict outbound proxies. I added a short migration checklist, a systemd unit example for a KMS proxy, and an SDK TLS adapter snippet for long-lived connections. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4567 — need quick reviews from infra/security/docs.

maria: Thanks — will review. Can you drop the new content under docs/private/egress-lockdown.md? Also please include a small port mapping table (egress vs control-plane).

evan: Quick read: the systemd unit looks fine but we should add Restart=on-failure and a simple ExecStartPre that waits for /etc/resolv.conf to be populated in sealed environments. Also add LimitNOFILE=65536.

lee: Note on NAT: if customers use SNAT policies at the edge, the KMS connection may see ephemeral source IPs and HSM ACLs can block that. Add a troubleshooting bullet to mention preserving source IP (or list the HSM allowlist option).

samir: Security ask: do NOT include any inline certs or keys in the docs. Recommend a snippet showing how to point to KMS client certs via env var e.g. REDWOOD_KMS_CERT=/etc/redwood/client.crt. Also add a note about ciphers: we require TLS1.2+ and ECDHE curves.

claire: Good catches. I pushed two commits: one moves file to docs/private/egress-lockdown.md and adds a short port table + a 'why source IP matters' note. Also swapped in Restart=on-failure and LimitNOFILE. PTAL.

maria: Small style nit: use imperative mood for the steps and add a one-line summary at top. I fixed the language in a follow-up commit.

claire: I included an SDK snippet for Python showing a requests TransportAdapter that sets a persistent HTTP/1.1 pool and respects proxy env vars. Example pasted below — we should ensure it's minimal and tested.

claire: ```python
import requests
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

session = requests.Session()
retries = Retry(total=3, backoff_factor=0.2)
session.mount('https://', HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retries, pool_maxsize=50, pool_connections=10))
# honor HTTPS_PROXY/NO_PROXY from environment
resp = session.post('https://kms.internal.example/v1/sign', json={'data': '...'}, timeout=10)
print(resp.status_code)
```

evan: +1 on the snippet. One suggestion: use timeout on connect and read separately ( (3, 10) ) so connection attempts fail fast during blocked egress.

samir: Add a short HSM failover example: if primary HSM can't be reached, fallback to a queued signing mode that buffers requests to disk (encrypted) and retries once network is restored. This is high-level only — don't ship implementation.

lee: For testing, include a quick command to simulate egress-lockdown with nftables so customers can validate the installer behavior. E.g.: `nft add rule inet filter output ip daddr != 10.0.0.0/8 drop` and then run the conn-checker.

maria: I updated the example commands to escape backticks and added a short 'what to expect' section for the conn-checker output. Also fixed a stale link in the installer reference.

docs-bot: PR 4567 updated: moved file, added port table, fixed link. (CI: docs-build passed) :white_check_mark:

claire: Thanks everyone. Can we get final LGTM from security and infra so I can merge later today? Planning to add a follow-up later with a short troubleshooting playbook.

samir: LGTM from security, thanks for the cert/env var guidance.

lee: LGTM from infra after the added notes about SNAT and conntrack.

maria: Merging after a tiny copy edit I did. Will follow-up if anything else shows up in staging. :thumbsup:

claire: Merged. Thanks all — I'll raise the follow-up playbook PR next week.
